program.eligibility: Hardware startups (robotics, digital healthcare, mobility, smart devices) with a prototype and at least angel-stage funding

application.how_to_apply: INTOPS hardware accelerating program (Paper Program) open calls; direct inbound to INTOPS Investment

summary.en: Seoul-based CVC (est. 2018) wholly owned by EMS manufacturer INTOPS; a registered new-technology finance company with KRW 100B capital, KRW 185.9B AUM and 120 cumulative deals across 17 funds. Hardware/deep-tech focus (FuriosaAI, Neuromeka, space) plus a 10-week hardware accelerating program.
summary.local: 제조사(EMS) 인탑스의 100% 자회사 CVC(2018년 설립, 서울). 신기술사업금융전문회사. 자본금 100억·운용자산 1,859억·누적 120건·17개 펀드. AI반도체(퓨리오사AI)·로봇(뉴로메카)·우주 등 하드웨어 딥테크 투자 및 10주 하드웨어 액셀러레이팅 운영.
